sentences.text: 2. The learned HCGP has placed reliance on the judgment passed by the Division Bench of this Court in W.A.No.100276/2019 & connected matters disposed on 30.09.2020.
Placing reliance on the said judgment, he would point out that the lis in regard to validity of preliminary notification dated 04.03.1964 was subject matter in batch of writ petitions.

The Division Bench of this Court while considering the grievance of identically/similarly placed persons, who claimed to be in occupation of buildings and the consequential relief of declaration to declare the land acquisition proceedings pursuant to preliminary notification dated 21.09.1962 has lapsed in view of Section 24(2) of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 (for short "the Act") was negatived and dismissed by learned Single Judge in batch of writ petitions and confirmed by the Division Bench in Writ Appeal No.100276/2019 &
connected matters.

sentences.text: In the light of the judgment (cited supra) rendered by the Division Bench of this Court, the relief of declaration sought at Prayer No.(i) cannot be entertained.
Consequently, the petitioner is not entitled for any direction at the hands of this Court in the light of the judgment (cited supra) rendered by the Division Bench of this Court.
Accordingly, the writ petition, being devoid of merits, stands dismissed.
3. In view of disposal of the petition, pending interlocutory applications, if any, do not survive for consideration and are disposed of accordingly.

opennyai_summary.facts:
The captioned writ petition is filed seeking the following reliefs:
i) to declare that the acquisition proceedings against the petitioners pursuant to the preliminary notification dated 04.03.1964 stood lapsed in view of section 24(2) of the land acquisition rehabilitation and resettlement act, 2013 as per annexure-c;
ii) issue a writ in the nature of mandamus by directing the respondents not to dispossess in respect of the petitioners herein from their residential house properties.
The Division Bench of this Court while considering the grievance of identically/similarly placed persons, who claimed to be in occupation of buildings and the consequential relief of declaration to declare the land acquisition proceedings pursuant to preliminary notification dated 21.09.1962 has lapsed in view of Section 24(2) of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 (for short "the Act") was negatived and dismissed by learned Single Judge in batch of writ petitions and confirmed by the Division Bench in Writ Appeal No.100276/2019 &
connected matters.
opennyai_summary.ANALYSIS: Placing reliance on the said judgment, he would point out that the lis in regard to validity of preliminary notification dated 04.03.1964 was subject matter in batch of writ petitions.
